records.issue_text: app/models/topic_embed.rb:48 — Reading an unbounded remote response fully into memory before parsing lets a large page exhaust a worker's memory.
records.rationale: The finding points to line 48 in app/models/topic_embed.rb where `open(url).read` is called. This reads the entire remote response into memory before passing it to Readability::Document. The diff shows this code at lines 45-48: `doc = Readability::Document.new(open(url).read, ...)`. A malicious or very large remote page could exhaust worker memory since there's no size limit on the read operation.

records.issue_text: app/jobs/scheduled/poll_feed.rb:29 — Feed polling materializes the complete unbounded response and processes every item without a cap, allowing a large feed to monopolize worker memory and time.
records.rationale: The diff shows poll_feed.rb at lines 27-33 iterating over `rss.items.each` without any limit or cap. The code uses `SimpleRSS.parse open(SiteSetting.feed_polling_url)` which loads the entire feed into memory, then processes every item. A maliciously large or simply very large RSS feed could indeed consume excessive memory and worker time. This is a real resource exhaustion concern in the new code.
